title: 832. Sum of Distances in Tree

examples.explanation: Node 2 is the most central with total 6.

hints: Root the tree at 0: a bottom-up pass counts subtree sizes and the distance sums inside each subtree.

Reroot with the relation childAnswer = parentAnswer - subtreeSize[child] + (n - subtreeSize[child]), since moving the root across one edge shortens paths into the child subtree and lengthens all others.
A second top-down pass propagates the root answer to every node in linear time.
